description: Inline SVG icon: fetches one sanitized SVG file per icon from <base-path>/<set>/<name>.svg, sized by preset and labelled for assistive tech

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Icon name (required): the SVG filename without .svg

attributes.name: set
attributes.description: Icon set directory (lucide, phosphor, tabler, mage, bold, custom). Defaults to the nearest data-icon-set on the element, an ancestor or <html>, then lucide. Icons missing from the set fall back to Lucide.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Size preset relative to the font size: 1em, 1.25em, 1.5em, 2em, 2.5em, 3em

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name for a meaningful icon (role="img"). Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). Adding or removing it updates the icon live.

attributes.name: base-path
attributes.description: Icon base URL for this icon. Defaults to <html data-icon-path>, then the icons/ folder beside the Vanilla Breeze bundle the page loaded (so a CDN or subpath install needs no setting), then /cdn/icons.

attributes.name: data-flip-rtl
attributes.description: Mirror the glyph horizontally when the icon is in a right-to-left context (directional icons such as arrows and chevrons)

attributes.name: data-animate
attributes.description: Spins the icon while an ancestor has [data-loading] (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion)

attributes.name: data-error
attributes.description: Present when the icon could not be loaded from the requested set or the Lucide fallback; light-DOM content is shown instead

attributes.name: data-upgraded
attributes.description: Present while the element is connected and upgraded

properties.name: set
properties.description: Resolved set: set attribute, else nearest data-icon-set, else lucide

properties.name: basePath
properties.description: Resolved base URL: base-path attribute, else <html data-icon-path>, else /cdn/icons

properties.name: iconPath
properties.description: URL of the requested icon file (before any Lucide fallback)

structure.description: Optional fallback shown until the SVG loads and when it fails (data-error)
